permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Used to look up the weather forecast for where you are. A single location fix is taken in the background; your coordinates are never shown on screen.

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Downloads the weather forecast for your location from Open-Meteo, the on-device speech recognition model used for voice commands (downloaded once, then cached on the device), and, only if you add your own Gemini API key, sends a voice command's transcript to Google's Gemini API when Jarvis does not recognise it as a command.

permissions.name: g2-microphone
permissions.desc: Records a short clip from the glasses microphone when you open Jarvis, so a voice command like "timer 5 minutes" can be recognised. Recording stops as soon as a result is ready; nothing is recorded otherwise.
